Private credit and PE remain active: Cinven raises €2.3B, Bridgepoint sells €1.2B portfolio, Blackstone exits India RE

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil-driven inflation fears, US-Canada trade escalation, and 4.8% yield test create headwinds. Equities under pressure (stocks fell on oil rally). Volatility elevated. Gold and energy outperform. Auto and consumer discretionary lag.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle intact (Nvidia forecast, Salesforce numbers). EM capital formation (Dangote, Reliance, Tata/Africa) supports growth. Clean-power transition accelerates. But fiscal risk and trade fragmentation cap upside. 6-12 month path depends on Iran conflict resolution and trade deal progress.
